verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a SaaS platform, so a full data-export and exit story is a fair question, but the evidence documents no account-wide export of user data in open formats. The Downloads API only retrieves files fetched during a session. URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown conversion is a web-fetch feature. Turning agent runs into Stagehand scripts is adjacent, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
